> [!IMPORTANT]
> Two new paths ship broken: `neovate` launches interactively instead of running one headless turn, and `--rounds` runs drop the new probe receipt.
>
> Confidence: 4/5 · Safety: no new attack surface — the probe runs the selected binary's help with the launch's environment and refuses before any agent starts.
> Basis: 0 reproduced · 0 ran · 2 walked · 1 pointed · 0 rules cited · 0 verified fixes

**Reviewed changes** — local range `291c83ae5..98d8becd9`: the agent table grows by 32 cited headless rows and an identity probe guards six clashing binary names.

- **Agent table** — 32 shipped rows added across `internal/core/run/agents.go`, with argv and surface guards in tests.
- **Identity probe** — `run` executes a declared help command before a launch, refuses `agent-mismatch` before any agent starts, and stores a passing receipt in `launcher.json`.
- **Settings fields** — `probe_args` and `probe_match` are closed-key settings for operator agents, with `probe_match` required when `probe_args` is set.
- **Refusal surface** — new code registered in `refusalcodes.go`, the generated TS union, hints/golden, manual, troubleshooting and CLI help.
- **Verification** — probe unit tests, a two-stub `fx` eval and row/name archtests; size baselines and docs updated.

comments.body:
Neovate is interactive unless `-q` is present: its own parser sends a prompt to `runInteractive` when `argv.quiet` is false, so `--agent neovate` opens a TUI instead of completing one headless turn. Add the boolean `-q` to this row's args and update `internal/core/run/agents_internal_test.go:247` and `docs/manual.md:2190`, which currently pin the interactive argv as the contract.

<details>
<summary>Technical details</summary>

```markdown
## Affected sites
- `internal/core/run/agents.go:292-294` — row composes `neovate --model M --x PROMPT`, with no `-q`.
- `internal/core/run/agents_internal_test.go:247-250` — literal expectation pins that argv for launch and `--print`.
- `docs/manual.md:2190` — table lists only a positional prompt for `neovate`.
- Upstream https://github.com/neovateai/neovate-code/blob/master/src/index.ts — help says "interactive by default, use -q/--quiet for non-interactive mode"; `argv.quiet` selects `runQuiet` versus `runInteractive`.
## Required outcome
- The shipped row must invoke a one-shot non-interactive turn, and its argv test and manual row must agree on the flag.
## Suggested approach
- Set `Args: []string{"-q"}` (boolean flag, positional prompt stays last), then update the two literals.
```

</details>

A passing probe is stored on `args.probe` here, but the `--rounds` record in `internal/core/run/repair.go:77-87` builds a separate `launcher` literal with no `Probe` field, so a repair run never writes the `probe: {args, ok}` receipt promised at `docs/manual.md:2261`. Copy the field into that record (or share one constructor) and cover a `--rounds` probe launch in the receipt assertion.

<details>
<summary>Technical details</summary>

```markdown
## Affected sites
- `internal/core/run/service.go:351` — the only place `args.probe` is assigned.
- `internal/core/run/service.go:622` — one-shot `launch` carries it into the record.
- `internal/core/run/repair.go:77-87` — repair record omits it; `invoke` probes once before entering that loop.
- `internal/core/run/probe_internal_test.go:67-85` — receipt assertion exercises only the one-shot path.
## Required outcome
- Every launch record produced after a passing probe carries `probe.args` and `probe.ok`, regardless of round count.
```

</details>

This comment promises that a name in usage or the docs that no row answers fails the test, but `assertSurfaceNames` only checks that each shipped name appears in each surface; an invented or stale name passes. Compare the parsed name sets in both directions using the `names` already extracted, or narrow the comment to the one-direction check the test actually performs.

<details>
<summary>Technical details</summary>

```markdown
## Affected sites
- `internal/archtest/agent_sources_test.go:36-37` — the two-way claim.
- `internal/archtest/agent_sources_test.go:65-72` — one-way `strings.Contains` assertion over shipped names.
## Required outcome
- Either the guard detects a documented name with no shipped row, or the comment stops claiming it does.
```

</details>

security_summary: No new attack surface: the probe runs the already-selected agent binary's fixed help argv with the launch's environment and a 5-second, 64 KiB cap, and it refuses before any agent process starts; no new network path or credential read is introduced.
